claim_boundary: These are real Agent executions on controlled coding fixtures. They do not establish performance on production repositories or other Agent versions.

boundary.en: This is a prompt change within the same Agent, not a comparison of two Agent identities or production repositories.
boundary.zh: 这是同一 Agent 下的 Prompt 变更，不是两个 Agent 身份或生产仓库的比较。

summary.en: Compare 60 real Codex executions across ten controlled tasks and three repeated trials.
summary.zh: 比较十个受控任务、三次重复中的 60 次真实 Codex 执行。

next_action: Resolve the listed evidence gaps before promotion.
